methodology.primary: Method 2 (M2): Compare treatment trajectory to null (a000_s42_fp32) trajectory at same generation. onset = first t where |treatment(t) - null(t)| > 2 * sigma_null_temporal. sigma_null_temporal = std of null metric values across all 11 generations (0-10).
methodology.robustness: Method 3 (M3): Compare relative percent changes from gen0 (treatment vs null). Normalizes domain/scale differences. onset = first t where |pct_treatment(t) - pct_null(t)| > 2 * sigma_null_pct.
methodology.baseline: a000_s42_fp32 (alpha=0, no synthetic data, seed 42, fp32)
methodology.note_c4: C4 experiments use WikiText null baseline. M2 is confounded by domain shift; M3 (relative changes) gives cleaner comparison.

query1_alpha100.description: alpha=1.0 onset timing — does condition (6) break?
query1_alpha100.finding: Even at alpha=1.0, entropy leads diversity by 1 generation (t_H=1, t_D=2). No simultaneous collapse. Condition (6) remains empirically viable.

query2_c4.description: C4 domain cascade onset — does A1 hold across domains?
query2_c4.finding: M2 shows simultaneous onset on C4, but this is a domain-confound artifact (comparing C4 treatment to WikiText null). M3 (relative changes, domain-normalized) recovers the standard cascade: t_H=1, t_D=2. A1 holds on C4 when properly normalized. MAUVE onset earlier on C4 (gen 1) vs WikiText (gen 3-7+).

query3_low_alpha.description: Low-alpha entropy onset — does gen-1 artifact hypothesis hold?

a010_s42_fp32.note: Entropy deviation from null at gen1 = 0.0045, well below threshold 0.121

query3_low_alpha.finding: Gen-1 artifact hypothesis refuted. At alpha<=0.25, entropy does NOT onset (t_H=None in M2, gen1 deviation 0.004-0.011, far below threshold 0.121). Phase transition at alpha~0.30: gen1 entropy deviation jumps from 0.011 to 0.483. If gen-1 onset were an artifact, it would appear at all alpha values — but it is clearly alpha-dependent. Additionally, distinct_n gen1 deviations are always sub-threshold (0.000-0.019), demonstrating metric-specific sensitivity, not methodological artifact.

summary.cascade_ordering_universal: Among experiments where entropy exceeds the 2sigma detection threshold (alpha>=0.30), t_H <= t_D holds in 15/15 cases (t_H=1, t_D=2 uniformly). For alpha<0.30 (5 experiments), entropy remains below the 2sigma threshold (gen-1 deviation 0.004-0.011, threshold 0.121), so cascade ordering is neither confirmed nor refuted — signal below detection resolution. Theory-consistent: small alpha produces perturbation within the diversity margin, satisfying condition (6) trivially.
summary.t_D_invariant: t_D = 2 in all 17 WikiText experiments (M2), regardless of alpha, seed, or whether entropy has onset. C4 experiments show t_D=1 under M2 (domain confound) but t_D=2 under M3 (domain-normalized). Diversity onset is locked to gen 2 when properly normalized.
summary.alpha_threshold: Sharp phase transition for entropy onset between alpha=0.25 (sub-threshold) and alpha=0.30 (strongly above). Gen1 entropy deviation jumps 60x: 0.008 -> 0.483.
summary.gen1_artifact_status: Refuted. The gen-1 entropy signal is alpha-dependent (absent at low alpha) and metric-specific (distinct-n never triggers at gen 1). Both properties are inconsistent with a methodological artifact.
